stem_book: Equal volumes of three strong acid solutions of pH 3, 4 and 5 are mixed in a vessel. What will be the H⁺ ion concentration in the mixture? (a) 3.7×10⁻³ M (b) 1.11×10⁻³ M (c) 1.11×10⁻⁴ M (d) 3.7×10⁻⁴ M
